privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires a Page (not a Post) titled 'Urban Photography Portfolio'. Required Alt Texts: city-skyline.jpg: 'City skyline at golden hour'; street-market.jpg: 'Busy street market with vendors'; bridge-sunset.jpg: 'Historic bridge during sunset'; historic-building.jpg: '19th century stone building facade'; park-fountain.jpg: 'Ornamental fountain in city park'. The intro text must be: 'A curated collection of urban photography capturing the beauty of city life, architecture, and public spaces.' The final status must be 'publish'.
